selector.rationale: The patient's clinical worsening despite antivirals and antibiotics, along with the presence of generalized myoclonus and the failure of levetiracetam to improve the myoclonus, supports the diagnosis of Autoimmune Encephalitis. The normal brain MRI and lack of focal or periodic features on EEG also align with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
rejected.why: The patient's age and lack of characteristic EEG findings make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Infectious Encephalitis
rejected.why: The patient did not improve with empiric antiviral and antibiotic treatment, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis
rejected.why: This diagnosis is less likely due to the lack of specific findings and the patient's clinical presentation not fully aligning with this condition.
